query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `crawler_performance_stats` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  `rule_id` int NOT NULL,
  `website_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `total_attempts` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `successful_attempts` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `failed_attempts` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `average_response_time` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `data_quality_score` decimal(5, 2) DEFAULT 0.00,
  `error_messages` json,
  `last_run_at` timestamp NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_rule_id` (`rule_id`),
  INDEX `idx_website_name` (`website_name`),
  INDEX `idx_last_run_at` (`last_run_at`)
)
